policies.name: Commercial General Liability (Crum & Forster)
policies.description: Comprehensive coverage for third-party bodily injury and property damage.
policies.fullDescription: Provides coverage for bodily injury and property damage to third parties, including products/completed operations, personal and advertising injury, and medical expenses, underwritten by Crum & Forster Specialty Insurance Company.
keyFeatures: High General Aggregate limit of $2,000,000.
Includes Products/Completed Operations Aggregate of $2,000,000.
Personal and Advertising Injury coverage up to $1,000,000.
Medical Expense Limit of $5,000 per person.
Rated A+ (Superior) carrier.

covered: A customer slips and falls on your property, sustaining an injury.
Damage caused by your completed roofing work to a client's property.
A lawsuit alleging libel or slander from your advertising.
notCovered: Damage to your own tools or equipment.
Losses due to certified acts of terrorism if not elected.

policies.name: Terrorism Insurance Coverage (Crum & Forster GL)
policies.description: Optional coverage for certified acts of terrorism for the GL policy.
policies.fullDescription: Provides optional coverage for losses resulting from certified acts of terrorism, as defined by the Terrorism Risk Insurance Act, for the Crum & Forster General Liability policy, subject to specific limitations and government reimbursement rules.
keyFeatures: Covers certified acts of terrorism as defined by TRIA.
Subject to government reimbursement under TRIA.
Optional coverage, can be accepted or rejected.

covered: Property damage or bodily injury resulting from a certified act of terrorism.
Business interruption losses directly caused by a certified terrorist event.
notCovered: Acts of terrorism not certified by the Secretary of the Treasury.
Losses exceeding the $100 billion cap under TRIA.

policies.name: Commercial Excess Liability (Nautilus Insurance Company)
policies.description: Additional layer of liability protection above primary policies.
policies.fullDescription: Provides an additional layer of liability coverage of $1,000,000 over the underlying Commercial General Liability policy, increasing the overall protection limits, underwritten by Nautilus Insurance Company.
keyFeatures: Increases liability limits by $1,000,000 per occurrence and aggregate.
Covers over primary General Liability limits.
Underwritten by Nautilus Insurance Company, rated A+ (XV).
Defense costs are in addition to the limit of liability.

covered: A large claim exceeding your primary GL limits for a bodily injury incident.
Additional protection for a significant products/completed operations lawsuit.
Extended coverage for personal and advertising injury claims.
notCovered: Claims not covered by the underlying GL policy.
Losses due to specific exclusions listed in the excess policy (e.g., Cyber Incident, PFAS).
Claims below the underlying GL limits.

policies.name: Terrorism Insurance Coverage (Nautilus Excess Liability)
policies.description: Optional coverage for certified acts of terrorism for excess liability.
policies.fullDescription: Provides optional coverage for losses resulting from certified acts of terrorism, as defined by the Terrorism Risk Insurance Act, for claims exceeding underlying limits, subject to specific limitations and government reimbursement rules. Not offered in this quote configuration.
keyFeatures: Covers certified acts of terrorism for excess claims.
Subject to TRIA reimbursement.
Not offered in this quote configuration.

covered: Large bodily injury or property damage claims from a certified act of terrorism that exceed primary GL and excess GL limits.
notCovered: Acts of terrorism not certified by the Secretary of the Treasury.
Losses exceeding the $100 billion cap under TRIA.

policies.name: General Liability (Mesa Underwriters Specialty Insurance Company)

keyFeatures: General Aggregate Limit of $2,000,000.
Products/Completed Operations Aggregate of $2,000,000.
Personal & Advertising Injury Limit of $1,000,000.
Each Occurrence Limit of $1,000,000.
Rated A+ (XV) carrier.

covered: A visitor is injured on your business premises due to a hazard.
Property damage to a client's home caused by your operations.
Defense costs for a lawsuit alleging false advertising.
notCovered: Damage to your own business property.

policies.name: Terrorism Insurance Coverage (Mesa GL)
policies.description: Optional coverage for certified acts of terrorism for the Mesa GL policy.
policies.fullDescription: Provides optional coverage for losses resulting from certified acts of terrorism, as defined by the Terrorism Risk Insurance Act, for the Mesa General Liability policy, subject to specific limitations and government reimbursement rules. Offered at no additional premium.
keyFeatures: Covers certified acts of terrorism as defined by TRIA.
Subject to government reimbursement under TRIA.
Optional coverage, offered at no additional premium.

covered: Property damage or bodily injury resulting from a certified act of terrorism affecting the insured's premises.
Business interruption losses directly caused by a certified terrorist event.
notCovered: Acts of terrorism not certified by the Secretary of the Treasury.
Losses exceeding the $100 billion cap under TRIA.

Minimum earned premium applies if policies are canceled.

coverageStrengths: High General Liability limits for both occurrence and aggregate.
